methodology: Reviewed development examples, including known failures. Frozen inputs; title hashes determine tuning/validation groups so repeated titles stay together. Threshold selection uses tuning records only. Small convenience sample, not independent population accuracy. Model scores include neutral. Runtime excludes download and initialization.

deploymentDecision.reason: Retain the deployed configuration unless a tuning-selected candidate improves correct validation assignments without incorrect validation assignments. The small development sample does not establish population accuracy.
